remaining_issues.title: Manager Chat POST 500
remaining_issues.description: Root cause: OPENAI_API_KEY was invalid. Fix: (1) graceful degradation in retrieveRelevantMemories (returns [] on failure), (2) new valid key 'seatable-embeddings' created on OpenAI platform and deployed to all Vercel envs + .env.local. Embeddings now work for memory-augmented chat.
